facts.claim: Ovation of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2016; 167,800 GT; 4100 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Quantum class.
Ovation of the Seas one of the world’s most groundbreaking ships. Fantastic entertainment, game-changing family fun you can enjoy in any climate, and breathtaking vistas from every stateroom.
Alaska adventures on the newly Amplified Ovation of the Seas® go all out with upgraded experiences.
Ovation of the Seas is a Quantum-class cruise ship owned by Royal Caribbean International (RCI) and the third ship of her class.

catalogSpecs.description: Quantum-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2016; 167,800 GT; approx. 4,100 guests at double occupancy.
